 CORAM:HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE BHARGAV D. KARIA  Date : 21/07/2023

ORAL JUDGMENT 1.Heard learned Advocate Mr. Tejas P. Satta for the appellant and learned AGP Mr. Kurven NEUTRAL CITATION C/FA/3022/2023 JUDGMENT DATED: 21/07/2023 undefined Desai for the respondent-State.
2.Admit.
Learned AGP Mr. Kurven Desai waives service of notice of admission on behalf of the respondent-State.

3.By this appeal, the appellant has challenged the Judgment and Award passed by the Principal Senior Civil Judge, Lalpur, dated 29.06.2018 in Land Acquisition Reference (LAR) Case Nos. 1 of 2008 in group LAR Nos.1/2008 to 3/2008 (main LAR No.1 of 2008) whereby the Reference Case was rejected.

entities.text: Land Acquisition Reference (LAR) Case Nos. 1 of 2008
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: 4.With consent of the learned advocates of both the sides the First Appeal is taken up for final disposal.

5.The land of the appellant-claimant situated at Village Jamjodhpur, Taluka Jamjodhpur, District Jamnagar was acquired for the NEUTRAL CITATION C/FA/3022/2023 JUDGMENT DATED:
21/07/2023 undefined purpose of Fulzar (KO.BA) Irrigation Project.
6.A notification under Section 4 of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 (for short "the Act") was published on 11.08.2006.
The Special Land Acquisition Officer by Award dated 08.02.2008 in Land Acquisition Case No.14 of 2005 awarded Rs.6.50/- per square meter.

7.Feeling aggrieved and dissatisfied with the award passed by the Special Land Acquisition Officer,
the appellant-claimant preferred reference under Section 18 of the Act.

8.The Reference Court by the impugned Judgment and Award dated 29.06.2018 dismissed the claim petition filed by the appellant- claimant as the claimant could not remain present before the Court despite giving sufficient time and could not adduce any NEUTRAL CITATION C/FA/3022/2023 JUDGMENT DATED: 21/07/2023 undefined evidence in support of the claim.

It is recorded by the Reference Court that notice was issued to the claimant but thereafter due to his absence, the evidence was closed and the Reference Court therefore, held that the claimant failed to prove his case.

9.In such circumstances, when the claimant has remained absent to lead the evidence, the claimant is not entitled to interest from the date of impugned Judgment and Award till the date of passing of Ashwinkumar Trikambhai vs Gujarat Government on 21 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/186621766/
2 this order.

10. In similar facts, the Coordinate Bench vide order dated 03.10.2019 passed in First Appeal No.
4699 of 2019 and vide order dated 29.06.2022 passed in First Appeal No. 862 of 2022 and allied matters remanded the matter back to the Reference Court.
11. Considering the aforesaid decisions of NEUTRAL CITATION C/FA/3022/2023 JUDGMENT DATED: 21/07/2023 undefined the Coordinate Bench, it appears that while remanding the matter back, a view has been taken that the Competent Court after taking into consideration the material which may be placed on record by the claimant or the respondent authorities, can decide whether the landowner was entitled to enhanced compensation, however, the claimants would not be entitled to claim interest from the date of the impugned Judgment and Award till the date of passing the order by this Court.

12. Considering the view taken by the Coordinate Bench in the similar facts in other First Appeals,
the impugned Judgment and Award deserves to be interfered with as the Reference Court could not have rejected the Reference Case merely on the ground that no evidence is led by the claimant- appellant.

The Reference Court ought to have taken an independent decision relying upon NEUTRAL CITATION C/FA/3022/2023 JUDGMENT DATED: 21/07/2023 undefined the necessary documents including the award in question as well as other comparable sale instances of the surrounding land, earlier award etc. passed with regard to the land in the near vicinity.
13.

Therefore in order to give a fair opportunity to the appellant before the Reference Court, the impugned Judgment and Award dated 29.06.2018 passed by the learned Principal Senior Civil Judge, Lalpur in Land Acquisition Reference Case No.1 of 2008 is hereby quashed and set aside so as to give an opportunity to the appellant-claimant to lead any evidence, if required, but the appellant-claimant would not be entitled to any interest for the period from the date of impugned Judgment and Award of the Reference Court till today i.e. from 29.06.2018 to 21.07.2023 on the enhanced amount of compensation if any.

Such exercise shall be completed within a period of six months from the date of receipt of this order.
14. With the aforesaid observation and direction, this appeal is partly allowed.
No order as to costs.
